_comment: Shared fixture table for src/content/pyq-provenance.ts and its hand-synced mirror frontend/src/lib/pyq-provenance.ts. Both implementations are driven over every case in src/content/__tests__/pyq-provenance.test.ts, so a change to one that is not made to the other fails CI. `row` is a partial pyq-bank row; `citable` and `label` are what BOTH must produce.
